## Graco in the News: Electrostatic Spray Technology and Cost Savings


Graco has been featured in leading trade publications for its innovation and customer-focused approach to solving real-world challenges. Recently, Graco subject matter expert Wendy Hartley shared insights on electrostatic spray technology with several industry publications, highlighting how the technology can help manufacturers reduce material waste and improve efficiency, an increasingly important topic as material costs continue to rise.


### CoatingsPro


#### Improving Coating Efficiency: Why Electrostatics Are Back in Focus


In *CoatingsPro* , Hartley discusses how rising material costs are prompting manufacturers to take a closer look at their operations and performance. Many companies are looking for ways to increase efficiency without making major changes to existing operations. In the article, Hartley explains how electrostatic spray technology can help improve transfer efficiency and reduce material waste.


[Click here](https://content.ampp.org/coatingspro/magazine-article/16189/Improving-Coating-Efficiency-Why-Electrostatics) to read the full article.


### Finishing & Coating


Hartley was also featured in *Finishing & Coating* where she explained how electrostatic spray technology works and how it can help improve productivity while maintaining finish quality.


#### TechTalk: Wendy Hartley, Graco, on Electrostatic Spray Technology

### Fleet Equipment Magazine


In *Fleet Equipment Magazine* , electrostatic spray technology was highlighted as a way to reduce coating waste. Hartley discussed how improved transfer efficiency can help manufacturers maximize material usage and control costs.


“As manufacturers evaluate ways to control costs, many are revisiting technology that can help improve operational performance,” said Hartley.


[Click here](https://www.fleetequipmentmag.com/electrostatic-spray-technology-coating-waste/) to read the full article.


### Products Finishing


In *Products Finishing* , Hartley answered questions relating to electrostatic spray technology and how it can be used to help with cost and material savings.


[Click here](https://www.pfonline.com/articles/electrostatic-spray-technology-for-cost-material-savings) to read the full article.


#### A proven technology with renewed relevance


Electrostatic spray technology is well established in the industry but has gained renewed attention as manufacturers look for ways to improve efficiency. By improving transfer efficiency, electrostatic systems help manufacturers get more from the coating materials they have already purchased while minimizing overspray and waste.


When properly configured and applied, electrostatic spray technology can reduce material waste by up to 60%, depending on the application.


[Learn more](https://www.graco.com/us/en/in-plant-manufacturing/products/liquid-coating/spray-booth/spray-guns-applicators/electrostatic-paint-spray-guns.html) about Graco’s electrostatic spray gun offerings and how they can help improve transfer efficiency and deliver consistent, high-quality finishes.
